title: Ban Appeal for my little brother

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

Your appeal is under review, expect a reply soon.

Thanks!

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your brother's infractions, I've decided to give him the benefit of the doubt and appeal his infraction. The last log-in was a long time ago, I personally thought he got away with ban evading, but it seems different now. Thus, his punishment will be appealed. My question is, why are you appealing for him? Couldn't he appeal himself?

Cheers!
